# Turn your git history into a timesheet your client can read

> Paste your git log and get estimated hours per day, a client-ready work summary in Markdown or CSV, and an invoice figure at your hourly rate. Free, private, runs in your browser; CLI included.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
